title: Figures 10-11: AFFDL-7C/D lifting body concept rendering and inward-turning inlet drawing
description: Figure 10 is a blue shaded rendering titled "AFFDL-7C/D Lifting Body Configuration Concept" with callouts ("Flight tested nose tip design assures 100 °C temperature," "Heat pipe leading edges," "Flat pane TPS system," "Trapezoidal cross section...," "All-flying control surfaces... from Mach 0.2 to 22"), plus an inset black-and-white photo of a model labeled "Dale Reed NASA Dryden circa 1967"; caption: "Figure 10. FDL-7C/D and FDL-7MC Lifting-Body Configuration." Figure 11 is a side-view line drawing captioned "Figure 11. FDL-7C/D with a DuPont Retractable Inward-Turning Inlet."
